# Codex Reference Adapter

This directory contains the rendered reference adapter config for Codex (ChatGPT subscription via OpenAI API).

## Generated files

- `manifest.json`: adapter metadata and supported commands
- `README.md`: this file

## Usage

This adapter is generated by `./bin/lac client render codex-reference`. It is not a primary client — it exists for users who want to reuse an existing ChatGPT subscription with the local cluster tooling.

For setup, see `docs/providers/CODEX_AUTH.md`.
